titleZh: 单元复习:旅行中的麻烦事
goalZh: 综合用物主代词、描述物品、不规则过去式和帮忙的说法,完整讲一次旅途中的麻烦并回应别人的故事
canDoZh: 能完整地讲一次旅途中的麻烦和别人的帮助,并回应别人的故事

newItems.noteZh: 朋友、同事出门回来时说;回答 Thanks! It's good to be back.。
It was a real adventure! 真是一次冒险!;重音在中间 ad-VEN-ture,结尾 -ture 读 /tʃɚ/。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Lei! Welcome back! We love your postcard.
lines.zh: (开学前一周,咖啡馆重新开门的第一天,墙上贴着磊寄来的明信片)磊!欢迎回来!你的明信片我们太喜欢了。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Yes, thank you! So, how was LA?
lines.zh: 是啊,谢谢你!那么,洛杉矶怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: It was great, but I lost my phone!
lines.zh: 挺好的,就是我把手机弄丢了!

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Oh no! Did you find it?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Yes! The driver found it in his car and called me.
lines.zh: 找到了!司机在车里发现了,给我打了电话。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And at the lost and found, Sofia found her cap!
lines.zh: 还有,在失物招领处,索菲亚找到了她自己的帽子!

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: It was mine, but I didn't see it was gone!
lines.zh: 那是我的,可我都没发现它丢了!

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Ha! And how was your trip home?
lines.zh: 哈!那回来的路上顺利吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: There was a big storm, so we spent one more night in LA.
lines.zh: 西雅图来了一场大暴风雪,所以我们在洛杉矶多待了一晚。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: And Lei helped a lady with her heavy bag.
lines.zh: 磊还帮一位女士拿了很重的行李。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Nice! I lost my guitar on a bus one time.
lines.zh: 不错嘛!我有一次把吉他落在公交车上了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: No way! Did you find it?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Yes. The bus driver kept it for me.
lines.zh: 找回来了。公交司机帮我收着呢。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: So it was a real adventure!
lines.zh: 看来这真是一次冒险啊!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! But it's good to be home.

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:讲一次旅途中的麻烦
grammar.bodyZh: 这个单元讲旅途中的麻烦和帮助,几种说法常一起用:① 丢东西、找东西:I lost my phone. / I can't find it anywhere. / When did you last have it?;② 说东西是谁的:Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine!(mine、yours、hers、ours、theirs 后面不跟名词),Whose cap is this?;③ 描述东西:a black phone with a blue plastic case、a small brown leather bag(大小 → 颜色 → 材质);④ 讲经过用过去式:lost、found、gave、spent、sat,用 First… / After that… / Finally… 串起来;⑤ 主动帮忙:Can I help you with that? / Let me carry it.。听别人讲故事时记得回应:No way! / Did you find it? / I can't believe it!。发音:lost、last 的 l 和 not、no 的 n 再练一遍。
